confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Panama City prices, not from live listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately confident; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because accommodation prices vary a lot by neighborhood (Casco Viejo, Obarrio, Costa del Este) and season. Panama uses the US dollar, so USD anchors carry no currency-conversion uncertainty. FX is the RBA 15 Oct 2026 observation (0.6955) reported in search results; I could not open the RBA table directly, and a 16 Oct figure (0.6947) from a third-party site is unverified and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to the Latin American dollarized capital tier, using San José (Costa Rica) and other mid-sized Latin American capitals as reference points, adjusted upward for Panama City's higher hotel and mid-range restaurant prices in the central business and Casco Viejo areas. Beer and cocktail estimates use the typical local ratio of bar prices to draft beer; wine was estimated as a fixed premium over the cocktail price because direct knowledge is weak.
